chemical_assumptions: C1: the local22 pocket sites A:VAL:116:N, A:VAL:116:O, A:VAL:66:CG2 and A:VAL:116:CA are treated as a mixed polar/hydrophobic sub-pocket; the terminal N at slot 22 is an aromatic acceptor-type nitrogen, and the two C slots (6,13) are aromatic carbons. C2: the local15 pocket sites A:VAL:53:CG1, A:MET:163:CE, A:HIS:160:CE1 and A:HIS:160:NE2 are treated as a hydrophobic/aromatic sub-pocket with a histidine edge; the terminal N at slot 15 is an aromatic donor-type nitrogen. These are terminal observations, not certified early-state roles; nearest polar pocket atoms do not establish H bonds or energetic contributions, and element fractions are not verified H-bond/functional-group roles. No microstate, protonation or tautomer claim is made.
clock_and_representation: Clock policy: fixed. Observable: predictive_bridge_to_learning_end. Teacher: actual_ancestor_at_learning_end. Representation: actual current world coordinates in A for the current state, and same-forward teacher predicted endpoint coordinates in A for the teacher target. Current versus endpoint targets must not be exchanged; early identity remains uncertain. The ancestor evidence provides current_clock_times [0.0, 0.12, 0.25, 0.5] and selected_ancestor_coords_A for both supports, so the local22 and local15 supports can be compared at the same clock times without mixing clocks.
component_response_interpretation: The parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE response shows 40 active and 40 nonzero updates, no atom clipping, no cumulative clipping, dose_gain_mean 1.0, and mode_switches 0.0, with current_gradient_rms_mean rising from 0.0112 to 0.0071 (mean 0.0080). This confirms the control term is activated and the instruction-to-function execution is real, but it does not establish geometric or elemental formation, suffix retention, or terminal affinity benefit. The parent outcome (mean_all_pic50 7.7108, best_qualified_pic50 8.5901, n_qualified 48/50) is the comparison baseline, not a guarantee that the local22 intervention will improve it. Nonzero raw component gradient does not establish a significant change in the normalized total direction; component/total fraction and cosine would need to be read separately.
falsifier: The hypothesis is falsified if, under matched dose and the same fixed clock, the local22 support shows no distinguishable terminal element layout or tracked NC joint fraction from the local15 support, or if the terminal N does not remain at the acceptor-type position, or if the local22-guided terminal affinity/quality is not distinguishable from the matched local15 comparison and the parent outcome. It is also falsified if the local22 layout forms during the window but is lost in the unguided suffix (formation without retention), or if the observed change is attributable to dose/normalization cancellation rather than the support choice.
formation_retention_value_test: Formation: at the window end, read the actual boundary geometry and element layout of the tracked local22 support (slots 6,13,22) and check whether the C,C,N terminal pattern is present at the expected local positions. Retention: compare the same tracked support's layout at the window end against the unguided suffix terminal, using the same support and the same correspondence rule, to test whether the layout persists after guidance stops. Value: compare terminal affinity/quality of the local22-guided run against the matched local15 comparison and against the parent R15_V3_COMPATIBLE outcome (mean_all_pic50 7.7108, best_qualified_pic50 8.5901, n_qualified 48/50). Zero clipping or constant dose during control is not retention evidence; nonzero component VJP is activation only, not formation.
observable_change: Under the fixed clock, the observable is the predictive bridge from the current state to the learning-end ancestor for the three local22 slots. Expected change: the local22 slots' predicted bridge geometry should move toward the same-forward teacher endpoint for those slots, and the terminal element layout at the window end should show the C,C,N pattern retained on the tracked local22 support. A distinguishable outcome would be a terminal tracked NC joint fraction and terminal element fraction on local22 that differ from the local15 comparison under matched dose, with the terminal N remaining at the acceptor-type position rather than migrating to the donor-type position.
relationship_to_failed_families: The prior campaign readout records that local identity formation did not equal affinity benefit (R03 terminal N geometry match 95.8% with best qualified pIC50 8.127753; R16_v2 also formed N without a high-score tail), and that tighter fitting to a fixed point cloud was not the primary gap (S0 boundary RMS ~0.039 A vs R15_v2 ~0.129 A, with R15_v2 having higher terminal predicted affinity). It also records that the same element matching cost did not replicate benefits on a 3-point N/C region (R16) or a 4-point O region (R18), indicating support-background dependence. This hypothesis therefore does not assume that forming the C,C,N layout on local22 will by itself raise affinity; it tests a support/clock pairing against a matched local15 comparison, and treats formation, retention and terminal value as separate propositions.
scientific_hypothesis: Principal hypothesis: on the F_b011_s030 root (11:31), the local22 support (slots 6,13,22; terminal elements C,C,N) is a chemically grounded local NC layout whose terminal N (slot 22) is an aromatic acceptor-type nitrogen positioned near A:VAL:116:N/O and A:VAL:66:CG2, while the local15 support (slots 4,14,15) places its terminal N (slot 15) as an aromatic donor-type nitrogen near A:MET:163:CE and A:HIS:160:NE2. The two supports are geometrically distinguishable at the same clock times (local22 ancestor coords cluster near z≈10-13, local15 near z≈14-18), so a single principal intervention on local22 under the fixed clock (predictive bridge to learning end, teacher = actual ancestor at learning end) tests whether steering the acceptor-type N toward the VAL116/VAL66 sub-pocket produces a distinguishable terminal outcome relative to the donor-type N placement in local15. This is a local layout hypothesis, not a claim that the terminal N role is already present in early states, and not a claim that either support is causally superior.
support_reason: The local22 support is selected because its actual-ancestor geometry is distinguishable from local15 at the same clock times, its terminal N is an acceptor-type aromatic nitrogen, and its pocket context (VAL116 N/O, VAL66 CG2, VAL116 CA) is a mixed polar/hydrophobic sub-pocket that differs from the local15 hydrophobic/histidine context. The support is strictly local: slots 6,13,22 with orientation triplet [22,6,13] and the four listed pocket sites; the full adjacency for these slots is {6:[3,17,22], 13:[0,22], 22:[6,13]}, so the direct support union remains local. Fewer than all points is only a necessary condition; each included point has a mechanism or measurement use (terminal N acceptor role, two aromatic C neighbors, and the nearest pocket polar/hydrophobic atoms). Free degrees of freedom outside the direct constraint are retained, while acknowledging that model VJP can have indirect influence.
